title: Anchorage header
description: A sticky black header that starts as a full-width bar with a hairline under it and, over the first scroll, lifts into a floating rounded box the width of the page, 24px from the top. Logo left, five semibold links with soft hover tiles, a quiet log-in link and a cobalt button right. Phones always show the floating box, with a three-line button opening a menu card.
notes: lies over the next section (the hero art shows behind the phone box); pass overlay={false} on plain pages
the bar-to-box change is a CSS scroll-driven animation (desktop, where supported); elsewhere it stays as drawn
the phone menu is a native <details> disclosure, so it works without JavaScript
name: anchorage-header
